tasks.subject: Task 5: Implement ExchangeCalendar abstract base (TDD)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `ExchangeCalendar` abstract base with date-aware hooks for era-varying exchanges. 9 hooks: `regularHolidays`/`adhocHolidays`/`specialCloses`/`specialClosesAdhoc`/`specialOpens`/`specialOpensAdhoc`/`regularOpen(date)`/`regularClose(date)`/`weekmask(date)`. TZ-aware `schedule()` via luxon. Per-year caches for holidays/specialCloses/specialOpens. Adhoc time-overrides win over rule-driven; both win over `regular*(date)`.

**Files:** src/calendars/exchange-calendar.ts, src/calendars/exchange-calendar.test.ts

**Verify:** `npx vitest run src/calendars/exchange-calendar.test.ts` → green

```json:metadata
{"files":["src/calendars/exchange-calendar.ts","src/calendars/exchange-calendar.test.ts"],"verifyCommand":"npx vitest run src/calendars/exchange-calendar.test.ts","acceptanceCriteria":["abstract class with name/tz","9 hooks: regularHolidays, adhocHolidays, specialCloses, specialClosesAdhoc, specialOpens, specialOpensAdhoc, regularOpen(date), regularClose(date), weekmask(date)","schedule() resolution order: adhoc > rule > regular","isEarlyClose checks both rule and adhoc","Per-year caches","TestCalendar exercises era-varying weekmask, era-varying close, special-open and special-close adhoc"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: NYSEExchangeCalendar — full faithful port (1885+)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Faithful port of `pandas_market_calendars` NYSE calendar covering full historical range from 1885. Era-varying session times (10:00→09:30 in 1985; close 15:00→15:30→16:00); variable weekmask (Mon-Sat through 1952-09-29); all regular holidays with onset/sunset; all adhoc closures (presidential funerals back to Garfield 1881, weather closures, 1914 WWI, 1968 paperwork-crisis Wednesdays, 9/11, Sandy, etc.); rule-driven and adhoc special closes; adhoc special opens (1933 bank-holiday late-open). Custom NYD-Saturday rule (NO Friday closure).

**Upstream source:** pandas_market_calendars/holidays/nyse.py and calendars/nyse.py

**Files:** src/calendars/nyse.ts, src/calendars/nyse.test.ts

**Verify:** `npx vitest run src/calendars/nyse.test.ts` → green; parity gate green for all dates 2020-06+ (CALENDAR_IGNORE removal is Task 12).

```json:metadata
{"files":["src/calendars/nyse.ts","src/calendars/nyse.test.ts"],"verifyCommand":"npx vitest run src/calendars/nyse.test.ts","acceptanceCriteria":["name=NYSE, tz=America/New_York","2020-06-19/2021-06-18/2021-12-31 OPEN (parity bug fixes)","Era-varying open: 10:00 default, 09:30 from 1985-09-30","Era-varying close: 15:00 → 15:30 (1952-09-29) → 16:00 (1974-01-02)","Variable weekmask: Mon-Sat through 1952-09-29","All regular holidays from upstream incl onset/sunset (MLK 1998+, Juneteenth 2022+, Lincoln <=1953, Washington fixed <=1970 + 3rd Mon Feb 1971+, Memorial fixed <=1970 + last Mon May 1971+, Columbus <=1953, Election Day, Veterans/Armistice)","All adhoc closures from upstream back to 1881 (presidential funerals, 1888 blizzard, WWI 1914, 1933 bank holidays, JFK 1963, MLK/RFK 1968, paperwork-crisis Wednesdays, 9/11, Sandy, GHWB, Carter)","Rule-driven special closes (DAT 13:00 from 1992, Christmas Eve 1996+, July 3)","Adhoc special closes (1929 crash week, 1973-1975 oil crisis, etc)","Adhoc special opens (1933-03-15 12:00)"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: LSEExchangeCalendar — full faithful port (1801+)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Faithful port of `pandas_market_calendars` LSE/UK calendar covering full historical range. Era boundaries (Banking and Financial Dealings Act 1971, Early May from 1978, NYD substitute from 1974). All royal events as adhoc closures: weddings (Charles+Diana 1981, William+Kate 2011), coronations (Elizabeth II 1953, Charles III 2023), jubilees (Silver/Golden/Diamond/Platinum), state funerals (Churchill 1965, Queen 2022), Millennium Eve. Pre-1971 era: Whit Monday, August Bank Holiday (1st Mon Aug). Post-1971: Spring Bank Holiday, Summer Bank Holiday.

**Upstream source:** pandas_market_calendars/holidays/uk.py and calendars/lse.py

**Files:** src/calendars/lse.ts, src/calendars/lse.test.ts

**Verify:** `npx vitest run src/calendars/lse.test.ts` → green

```json:metadata
{"files":["src/calendars/lse.ts","src/calendars/lse.test.ts"],"verifyCommand":"npx vitest run src/calendars/lse.test.ts","acceptanceCriteria":["name=LSE, tz=Europe/London","Modern bank holidays (NYD, Good Fri, Easter Mon, Early May, Spring, Summer, Christmas, Boxing)","Era boundaries: Early May validFrom: 1978, Spring/Summer Bank Holiday validFrom: 1971, Whit Monday/August Bank Holiday validUntil: 1970","Christmas/Boxing substitution rules (Sat→Mon+Tue, Sun→Mon+Tue)","Royal weddings: 1981-07-29 + 2011-04-29 closed","Coronations: 1953-06-02 + 2023-05-08 closed","Jubilees: 1977-06-07, 2002-06-03, 2012-06-05, 2022-06-03 closed","State funerals: 1965-01-30 + 2022-09-19 closed","Millennium Eve 1999-12-31 closed","Early closes 12:30 London on Christmas Eve and NYE (weekday only)","Regular session 08:00-16:30 London"]}
```
